```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list=ls())
gc()

load.lib <- c("tidyverse", "data.table", "cowplot", "here")

install.lib <- load.lib[!load.lib %in% installed.packages()]

for(lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib,dependencies=TRUE)
sapply(load.lib,require,character=TRUE)

dir <- here(getwd())
              
```

# Read the acoustic data

```{r, read.acoustic.indices}

acoustic.indices <- fread(here(dir, "summerATsurvey_biomass.csv"), sep = ",") |>
  rename(Year = yr,
         est = obs,
         se = stderr) |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2008, 2012:2019)) |>
  mutate(origin = "Acoustic",
         est_mt = est,                      # Metric Tons estimate
         ymin   = est_mt * exp(-1.96 * se), # Log-normal lower 95% bound
         ymax   = est_mt * exp(1.96 * se)  # Log-normal upper 95% bound
         ) |>
  select(Year, origin, est_mt, ymin, ymax)

View(acoustic.index)

```

# Read the sdmTMB baseline model indices

```{r, read.sdmtmb.indices}

sdmtmb.indices <- fread(here(dir, "Final.Results", "area.abundance.indices_FullBaseModel.csv"), sep = ",") |>
    mutate(origin = "sdmTMB",
           est_mt = est/1000,                        # Metric Tons estimate
           ymin   = exp(log_est - 1.96 * se) / 1000, # Log-normal lower 95% bound
           ymax   = exp(log_est + 1.96 * se) / 1000, # Log-normal upper 95% bound
         ) |>
  select(Year, origin, est_mt, ymin, ymax)

View(sdmtmb.indices)

```

# Combine the two

```{r, }

# Combine both models
combined_data <- bind_rows(acoustic.indices, sdmtmb.indices) |>
  mutate(log_est_mt = log(est_mt),
         log_ymin = log(ymin),
         log_ymax = log(ymax)
  )

# Plot together with visible error bars
index.comparision <-
  ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Year, y = log_est_mt, color = origin, group = origin)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = log_ymin, ymax = log_ymax),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), 
                  size = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Acoustic Abundance Index Comparison",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Index ln(Metric Tons)",
    color = "Model / Source"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2008, 2019, by = 2)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

index.comparision

ggsave2(
  filename="USAcousticIndex.vs.sdmTMBIndex.withMultiNationalData.jpeg",
  plot=index.comparision,
  path=here(dir, "Final.Figures"),
  device = "jpeg", 
  dpi = 1200, 
  width = 45,   
  height = 21, 
  units = "cm", 
  limitsize = FALSE
  )

```
